name: Sugar Tree Farm
address: 1310 E Gregory Rd, Central Point, OR 97502

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large commercial agricultural facility with multiple white metal buildings and smaller buildings, including a residence|The majority of the property consists of extensive growing fields arranged in long, neatly planted rows|A large pond is visible on the site|A network of paved and dirt roads connects the buildings and fields|Numerous vehicles and trailers are parked near the buildings|The facility is situated in a rural agricultural area.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main cluster of white buildings with adjacent parking and storage areas containing multiple vehicles and trailers|Long rows of planted fields extend outward from the building complex|A pond is visible nearby, and dirt roads provide access through the growing areas|The layout supports large-scale agricultural operations with clear vehicle circulation.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows extensive rows of planted fields separated by dirt roads|White buildings are visible in the distance, along with additional storage areas and vehicles|A pond is located toward one side of the fields

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows multiple large growing fields with uniform rows of plants, separated by access roads|White buildings and vehicle storage areas are visible|A pond is located near the center of the rear section|The layout provides extensive open space and multiple routes for vehicle movement across the property.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows long rows of planted fields and dirt roads leading through the growing areas|White buildings and parking/storage zones with vehicles and trailers are visible|A pond is present near the fields|The site maintains a spacious, functional agricultural layout with roads connecting all parts of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is available through a network of paved and dirt roads that connect the main buildings, storage areas, and all growing fields. The large open layout and multiple access routes provide good movement and staging space across the facility. A pond is present on the property, which could serve as a water source but may also require consideration during emergency response. Numerous vehicles and trailers are parked on site. The facility is located in a rural agricultural area.
